architectureDecisions: Default progressPolicy=null preserves fixed maxAttempts. Opt-in {kind:"TREE_FAILURE_GRACE_V1"} validates before side effects and binds through BB-125.
Select two identical observations plus one grace retry: escalate at streak 2, stop at 3. Changed content/diagnostics resets. maxAttempts is always the hard ceiling.
Compare tree and typed failure digests, never SHA alone or summary text. Fresh verification/Core evaluation remain mandatory; no cached PASS.
Stop only typed pinned external SPAWN_ERROR or candidate integrity failure immediately; keep repository-local spawn failure, timeout and agent auth prose repairable/unknown.
Reuse canonical JSON and redaction helpers. Persist exact failed checks and decision before dispatch/cleanup; policy never supplies acceptance.
Extend BB-125 handle binding/state; deduplicate completed semantic attempts across replay. Keep terminal status EXHAUSTED with additive stopReason.
Retain adverse delayed4 control. No default enablement or broad quality/cost claim before accepted BB-099-compatible held-out comparison.
implementationSlices: S1 — supervisor.js; PROGRESS_POLICY/FAILURE_TAXONOMY. Add progressPolicy=null to strategy/run/resume; sole nonnull {kind:TREE_FAILURE_GRACE_V1}, extra keys reject. Bind canonical policy digest through existing BB-125 execution binding; preserve exact task/tool/model/permission/verifier/launch checks. Comparable fingerprint SHA256 canonicalJson({policyKind,executionBindingDigest,candidateTree,evaluationDisposition,checks:sortedByName}); tree from git rev-parse --verify candidateSha^{tree}, checks include name/claim/status/reason/exit/stdout-stderr hashes, revision excluded but retained provenance. Parse the exact five name-prefixed entries specified in progressPolicyContract.fingerprint.evidence; require unique complete record/current candidate/expected claim. Unknown or malformed clears streak to0. Fresh Core PASS+mutation still solely authorizes acceptance. Otherwise classify REVISION_MISMATCH/TREE_MUTATED immediate integrity stop; SPAWN_ERROR immediate setup stop only for pinned absolute external executable after realpath containment check, candidate-local/PATH commands repairable; TIMEOUT/prose unknown/transient, no immediate setup stop. Same comparable fingerprint streak+1, change starts1 and clears grace. At streak2 with budget persist one grace notice; streak3 persists EXHAUSTED/NO_PROGRESS before another ACT. maxAttempts remains hard ceiling, TOOL_UNAVAILABLE existing immediate path. No task-schema/CLI/Core changes. Integration points: in BOTH regular and skipFirstAct verifier loops retain validated full artifacts separately from current public attempt.verification records. After fresh EVALUATE and existing PASS/mutation guard, compute transition from those artifacts/current tree. Extend existing onActCompleted/onAttemptCompleted payloads with enabled-only progressState; persist stop decision through onAttemptCompleted before returning EXHAUSTED, not by throwing a sentinel. Add validated initialProgressState to strategy options for resume; regular fresh callers supply empty state, resume supplies verified handle state. Before next ACT use returned redacted feedback/grace instruction. Disabled path executes original branches and payloads.

S2 — packages/agent-tools/src/supervisor.js and recovery.js; EVIDENCE_FEEDBACK/DURABLE_POLICY. Enabled FEEDBACK_HEADER/maxFeedbackChars remain. Prioritize names/status/reasons, one grace repair instruction, then bounded excerpts. Redact with combined invocation secret set and containsSecret before storage. Store digests/full structured checks separately; prompt truncation sets feedbackTruncated/omitted count without dropping metadata. Enabled-only progressSummary={policyKind,policyDigest,stopReason,attemptIndex,candidateSha,candidateTree,executionBindingDigest,fingerprint,streak,graceIssued,failedChecks,feedbackTruncated,remainingDispatchBudget}. Remaining budget=max(0,maxAttempts-attemptIndex), not saved calls/cost. Disabled result/feedback/handle shape unchanged. State={version:1,policyDigest,lastCompletedAttempt,previousFingerprint,streak,graceIssued,lastDecision,lastEvidence,terminalSummary}. Extend delivered BB-125 create/assert/write handle explicitly; validate bounds/digests/candidate binding. Persist ATTEMPT_COMPLETED before another ACT. ACT_COMPLETED keeps prior completed state; fresh replay applies transition once from that state. Changed replay evidence recomputes, never double-counts. Terminal EXHAUSTED rejects resume. Missing/corrupt/drifting opt-in state rejects before probe/worktree/verifier; disabled legacy follows BB-125 migration. ACT_COMPLETED reruns verifiers, not ACT; ATTEMPT_COMPLETED reuses completed decision without resetting streak or adding grace. Record replay call counts separately; semantic attempts cannot prove total actual calls. Use delivered writeAgentToolRunHandle/createAgentToolRunHandle/validation; add opt-in policy binding and state in those existing functions, not an undeclared API. The versioned policy state above is the chosen schema; dependency DONE is solely an execution prerequisite. runRecoverableTask/resumeSupervisedTask thread the enabled state into both existing persistRecoverableHandle callbacks. ACT_COMPLETED stores prior completed state and current candidate as distinct provenance; ATTEMPT_COMPLETED stores transition for that semantic attempt. On Core accepted outcome clear repeat state and attach accepted terminal state to outcome; existing final wrapper persists it only after successful promotion. freezeSupervisedResult conditionally preserves outcome.progressSummary when enabled, otherwise original keys. Plain runSupervisedTask receives the same optional summary without recovery. No new Core evaluator/lineage or artifact schemas outside allowed supervisor/recovery files.

S3 — retry-progress-policy.test.js directly invokes the enabled and disabled strategy with real Git, fake CLI and external frozen assertions. Paired matrix fixed/repeat2/grace: repeated failure ceiling5 expects5/2/3 ACT and verifiers with no acceptance; delayed2 expects acceptance at2 in all arms; delayed3 at3 in fixed/grace and rejection in repeat2; multistep changed-tree and diagnostics-change fix at4 must accept in fixed/grace. Retain identical-prefix delayed4 as an adverse rejected control in grace, not a quality-preservation result; default stays disabled. Ceiling3 repeat demonstrates no saving. Log actual dispatches/verifiers/promotion and independent quality, not remaining budget or model gains. Also execute exact negative titles and both crash phases on product APIs. The measured research rows use the explicitly declared resultColumns; future product runs must reproduce the selected positive controls and report the adverse control unchanged.
S4 — Run mapped regressions/docs, collect exact candidate/plan/tree-bound evidence, and update the two Living docs with opt-in behavior and measured limits.

valueHypothesis.expectedValue: Fewer scheduled retries on frozen failures above the three-attempt grace window, and immediate termination of pinned unrecoverable setup/integrity failures.
valueHypothesis.measurement: Paired fixture ACT/verifier counts and independently frozen acceptance checks first. Fixed maxAttempts=3 has no frozen-repeat count benefit. Single-run elapsed times are telemetry. BB-099-compatible held-out quality/cost studies remain separate.
valueHypothesis.valueOwner: BB-099 for agent-tool comparison; BB-074 for end-to-end delivery value
valueHypothesis.target: At maxAttempts=5, frozen repeat fixture must reduce ACT/verifier counts from 5/5 to 3/3 without loss on preregistered delayed2/delayed3, changing-content and changing-diagnostics controls.
valueHypothesis.nonRegressionBoundary: A valid fourth-attempt fix following the identical failing prefix is stopped. Do not describe fixture non-regression as all-task quality preservation or promote this policy to the default.

progressPolicyContract.api: Optional progressPolicy=null on createSupervisedAgentStrategy, runSupervisedTask and resumeSupervisedTask. The sole non-null shape is {kind:"TREE_FAILURE_GRACE_V1"}; reject extra keys/unknown kinds. No AGENT_TASK_V1, CLI or Application schema changes.
progressPolicyContract.identity: Include credential-free canonical policy digest in delivered BB-125 execution binding before dispatch. Consume its exact original/materialized task/tool/model/permission/verifier/launch checks; never hash secrets or create a second task binding.

fingerprint.content: Argument-array git rev-parse --verify <candidateSha>^{tree>. Full tree includes modes/files/submodule entries; lookup failure aborts. Tree equality is conservative content equality, not semantic quality.
fingerprint.evidence: Parse only verifier.evidence entries with the exact declared name prefix and five keys: revision=<40hex>, exit=<signed integer or null>, reason=<LocalVerificationReason>, stdout-sha256=<64hex>, stderr-sha256=<64hex>. Require exactly one of each, record.candidate.version and revision equal current candidate, record.claim equal agent-task.<name>, and a valid PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE record.status. Split at the prefix/key delimiter, never from summary/prose; duplicate, malformed, foreign-prefix or missing required entry is EVIDENCE_UNKNOWN. Compare name/claim/status/reason/exit/stream digests; retain candidate revision as provenance only.
fingerprint.digest: SHA-256 canonicalJson({policyKind,executionBindingDigest,candidateTree,evaluationDisposition,checks:sortedByName}). Each check includes status/reason/exit/stream digests; exclude revision, attempt/time, feedback and SHA. Retain excluded provenance alongside.
fingerprint.unknown: Missing/malformed/duplicate evidence or invalid evaluator identity => EVIDENCE_UNKNOWN: clear streak and compare nothing, continue under ceiling without acceptance. Full TIMEOUT evidence may repeat; timeout alone is not setup.
fingerprint.pass: Check fresh Core PASS and existing mutation gate first. PASS without acceptable mutation uses NO_ACCEPTABLE_MUTATION disposition and complete check records, never a policy acceptance shortcut.

transition: After every complete verification+EVALUATE, honor only existing Core acceptance; otherwise classify setup/integrity first.
Same comparable fingerprint increments streak; changed fingerprint starts at 1 and clears grace; unknown evidence clears to 0.
At streak 2 and remaining budget persist one grace notice for this streak. At streak 3 persist terminal evidence and return EXHAUSTED/NO_PROGRESS/acceptedSha=null before next ACT.
Ceiling => EXHAUSTED/MAX_ATTEMPTS unless this attempt proves a more specific stop. Existing TOOL_UNAVAILABLE remains immediate. Agent exit/success/auth prose cannot provide verifier reason.

taxonomy.behavior: Complete fingerprints use grace; candidate-local dependencies remain repairable.

Immediate EXHAUSTED/CANDIDATE_INTEGRITY; retain all failures, acceptedSha=null.
Clear streak, ceiling-bound retry, no acceptance.
